description: What this data covers before you rely on it: the plan year, how many issuers and states are present, which states are included, and the counts of issuers whose denial or appeal figures CMS suppressed. Use to check whether a state or insurer is in scope at all, and to tell "we hold no data for this state" apart from "this state's insurers deny nothing" — the CMS Transparency in Coverage file covers HealthCare.gov states only.
name: insurer_denial_coverage
title: Insurer Denial Coverage
